title: Substrate Profile
description: The Ethotechnical classification of a deployment that replaces open-versus-closed. Ethotechnics does not favor open or closed models; it favors architectures where consequential authority can be inspected, constrained, contested, and reversed. A deployment is classified by nine properties rather than by weight access alone: weight access, runtime control, update authority, version stability, revocation, substitutability, observability, standing, and dependency. For each property the profile states who holds it, how strong the institution's position is, and the evidence.

schema_version.title: Schema version
schema_version.description: Version of this schema the profile conforms to.

profile_id.title: Profile identifier
profile_id.description: Stable identifier for the profile, referenced by the safety object model.

system_ref.title: System reference
system_ref.description: Identifier of the deployed system being classified.

assessed_at.title: Assessed at
assessed_at.description: When the profile was last assessed.

weight_access.title: Weight access
weight_access.description: Who can inspect or obtain the model weights.

runtime_control.title: Runtime control
runtime_control.description: Who controls the runtime the model executes in, including the ability to stop it.

update_authority.title: Update authority
update_authority.description: Who decides when the model or its policies change.

version_stability.title: Version stability
version_stability.description: Whether the deploying institution can pin a version and rely on it not changing underneath its evidence.

revocation.title: Revocation
revocation.description: Who can withdraw the model from service and how quickly.

substitutability.title: Substitutability
substitutability.description: Whether the model can be replaced by an alternative without unacceptable cost.

observability.title: Observability
observability.description: What the deploying institution can see of the model's behaviour and internals.

standing.title: Standing
standing.description: Whether error-bearing parties have a way to challenge the deployment's decisions.

dependency.title: Dependency
dependency.description: How dependent the institution has become on this substrate; see the dependency record for detail.

dependency_ref.title: Dependency reference
dependency_ref.description: Identifier of the dependency record backing the dependency property.

property.title: Substrate property
property.description: One of the nine classification properties: who holds it, how strong the deploying institution's position is, and the evidence.

holder.title: Holder
holder.description: Who controls this property, for example the provider, the deploying institution, or shared.

rating.title: Rating
rating.description: How strong the deploying institution's position is on this property.
